title: PAR-03/PAR-04 associative prefix-status handle accounting
scope: Report decoded handle counts at already-bounded associative action value, vertex-action-param, and osnap-point-ref-action-param prefixes.

change.summary: Action value-prefix statuses report the consumed handle-count delta; vertex action-param and osnap point-ref action-param statuses increment counts at each successful handle read.

generatedControl.formatVersion: AC1024 action values; AC1024 and AC1027 parameter prefixes
generatedControl.input: Generated in-memory associative-action vectors covering Real, Int16, Int32, String, XDATA string, XDATA handle-string, and handle-valued variants; generated vertex-action-param and osnap-point-ref-action-param frames.
checks: each complete value-prefix status reports two associated/trailing handle references for scalar and string variants
each complete handle-valued variant reports three handles, including the value handle
parent action status reports the per-value handle count plus its two leading object references
vertex action-param status reports its one consumed dependency handle
osnap point-ref action-param status covers zero and multiple compound handles, absent/present child parameters, zero/nonzero child IDs, and resulting exact counts 0/2/4/5
all generated vectors still reach the independent body sentinel

evidenceCeiling: Generated vectors verify diagnostics for already-bounded decoder paths only. Targeted lookup in the official ODA v5.4.1 PDF did not identify class-specific associative parameter grammar; no unresolved payload kind, width, or semantic support claim is promoted.
selfUnblockingContinuation: Continue PAR-03/PAR-04 only when exact field-context evidence supports a specific local correction; otherwise resume a locally evidenced HATCH/DWG semantic or DXF ownership slice. External semantic evidence and native FreeCAD Linux/Windows qualification do not pause local implementation.
